scene: You step off the glowing night tram into bustling Photo Bazaar.
picture: A flat side-view along a cobbled street. Far left sits the yellow night tram with open doors. Left is a red darkroom tent. Center stands the curly-haired boy in a denim jacket by a rack of drying photographs. Right features a wooden vendor stall holding a polished brass camera. Far right holds glowing lampposts.
shown: a glowing red darkroom tent flap standing slightly ajar on the left
a tall wooden rack pinned with glossy black-and-white photos at the centre
an antique brass folding camera resting atop a merchant counter on the right
